title: Different colors of items in the Menu?

posts.author: Arwo
posts.body:
Hey,
I'm looking for a simple solution - I will have 5 different types of items in my game:
Common,
Uncommon
,
Rare
,
Epic
,
Legendary
.
As shown above, I want such items to have a different color of the text when you look at it at the Equip menu etc.
What is the easiest way to do it? I am using
RPG Maker MZ.
Thanks!

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Haven't tried it yet, but this should work:
Use this plugin
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...t-use-escape-characters-in-any-window.128906/
and then use Color Codes in every Item, e.g.
\C[3]Health Potion

posts.author: Ahuramazda
posts.body:
Make a plugin using this bit of code:
Code:
Window_Base.prototype.drawItemName = function(item, x, y, width) {
    if (item) {
        const iconY = y + (this.lineHeight() - ImageManager.iconHeight) / 2
        const textMargin = ImageManager.iconWidth + 4
        const itemWidth = Math.max(0, width - textMargin)
        this.drawIcon(item.iconIndex, x, iconY)
        this.changeTextColor(ColorManager.textColor(item.meta.itemColor || 0))
        this.drawText(item.name, x + textMargin, y, itemWidth)
        this.resetTextColor()
    }
}
and then in an item, weapon, armor, skill notebox use:
Code:
<itemColor: id>
Should do exactly what you're wanting... works in menu, shops, battle menus and drops
